summary: Canadian Natural Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 third-quarter results press release (Exhibits 99.1–99.3), the US-equivalent of a routine earnings current report for a foreign private issuer on Form 40-F. Q3 production totaled roughly 1,652,000 BOE/d (about 1,217,000 bbl/d liquids plus 2.6 Bcf/d gas), including a planned Horizon turnaround; thermal in situ hit a record ~300,000 bbl/d and conventional liquids ~358,000 bbl/d. No transaction, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed.
